_description: Model parameters — values that define the Holistic Universe Model theory. Changing any value = different model. Source of truth for both tools/lib/constants.js and src/script.js.

foundational._psiNote: PSI is derived in constants.js from earthInvPlaneInclinationAmplitude: PSI = 3 × amp × √m_Earth
foundational._phaseOriginNote: Plan 07 R10: the correction combs measure their phase from J2000. The former phase origin (perihelionalignmentYear − temperatureGraphMostLikely 14.5 × H/16 = −302,635, the 'balanced year') and the System-Reset offset (systemResetN 7, in anchor units) were rotated out of the fitted coefficients exactly (tools/fit/reorigin-combs-j2000.mjs) and are no longer inputs; the literals gate fails if either key returns.

earth._kDeviceWheelPhaseNote: Plan 07 R10: the scene scaffolding's K-device wheel phase at J2000 in anchor-unit cycles — each H/N wheel (H/3, H/5, H/8, the H/16 pair, the H/13 wobble marker, the perihelion wheel's 270° convention) stands N × this on at J2000. Numerically the retired phase origin's (2000 − t₀)/H; kept as the device's RECORDED J2000 pose like earthtiltMean (the wheel geometry _kcFrameR bridges once), not a law. No observable rides it — the engine places the Earth frame, the Sun and the Moon stack over it — but the scene's world frame and every world-axis reader (the NASA-convention umbra diagnostic's aberration about world Y) do; measured: dropping it tilted the K pose 1.25° and moved that diagnostic 0.45″.

moon._moonMeeusLpCorrectionNote: RETIRED at plan 06 R3 item 1 (was 0.009097354859355077 deg = +32.75 arcsec, Step 5c moon-eclipse-optimizer). Measured against JPL Horizons' apparent Moon over 1970-2049 the series needs no anchor (-1.0 +/- 1.5 arcsec, flat in elongation); the value was the eclipse location tier's mean Sun compensated (its aberration kappa + the I2 long inequality + the trend-deltaT offset). Kept at 0 until the plumbing leaves (R4).

additionalBodies._description: angleCorrection and startpos were literals in src/script.js with no source of truth until now. (Plan 07 R8: the perihelionEclipticFraction pairs — [1,1] for all four, one full H standing in for four unrelated orbits — and the inclinationCycleAnchor phases left with the retired device; a body's perihelion period is the N-body chain's, and these four bodies have no chain.)
additionalBodies._typeNote: The minor-body `type` assignments are GEOMETRIC PLACEHOLDERS (borrowed from the planet I/II/III taxonomy so the shared geometry law can derive them). These bodies are more susceptible to planetary gravity disturbances and are expected to receive their own perturbation-aware type(s) in the precision-programme refit (Phase 20 post-renumber; pre-renumber 18). Note pluto/halleys currently derive via body-unique branches keyed on the body name in @essrt/physics/planets/geometry — their `type` field is not consumed by the derivation, so redefining it later changes nothing until the new branch is wired deliberately.

perihelionPassageRef._description: Planet perihelion passage reference JDs — phase-optimized for EoC alignment

deepTime._description: Deep-time (ESSRT) fitted/calibrated anchors — single source of truth. alpha1PerMa is LLR-anchored (da/dt = 3.82 cm/yr, Dickey 1994 / Chapront 2002); alpha3/alpha4 are the Farhat 2022 LSQ deep-time fit; the GIA channel is the LAGGED response of the polar moment to the ice history the climate formula's L1 proxies (@essrt/physics climate/l1-orbital createAlphaGiaChannel): alphaGiaRateJ2000PerYr is the Cox & Chao 2002 dJ2/dt / 2.0 Peltier factor rate the channel's coupling k is DERIVED from at runtime (no stored scale), alphaGiaRelaxationKyr the mantle relaxation time MEASURED against the historical DeltaT record through the joint fitter (optimum 5-6 kyr; the degree-2 Maxwell estimate) - plan 06 D7; j2RateJ2000PerYr is the OBSERVED dJ2/dt itself (Cox & Chao 2002, satellite laser ranging) - the scale of the same channel's second observable, J2(t)/J2_0 (createAlphaGiaChannel j2RatioAt), which the spin integration multiplies into the precession rate (psi-dot proportional to J2; plan 06 par. 9 item 10): stored as its own input so the precession side is anchored on the observation, independent of the J2-to-alpha conversion on the length-of-day side; the taper halfwidths bound the 4-flag DT stack. src/script.js imports these via the generated constants module (npm run constants:generate); tools/lib/deep-time.js reads via tools/lib/constants.js; the website consumes these through the published @essrt/physics package (DEFAULT_CONSTANTS.deepTime).

recessionRegime._description: Driver 1½ regime-aware lunar recession (2026-08): the quartic stays BIT-IDENTICAL ≤ jointMa (the Wells/Wu-gated era — its alpha set is the calibrated effective closed-budget pair); beyond, a monotone cubic Hermite through the fitted knots to the rigid Roche limit at genesisMa, plus the two explicit solar angular-momentum channels (ocean leak beta0·(a/a0)^6·tau_moon; insolation-driven thermal-tide pump factor·(tau_moon+leak) inside the window — Zahnle-Walker 1987 / Bartlett-Stevenson 2016 / Mitchell-Kirscher 2023, Zhou 2024's contrary reading recorded). Fit: tools/explore/fit-regime-recession.js against 11 published anchors (Lantink 2022 Joffre · Weeli Wolli · Zhou 2024 ×3 paired a+LOD · Meyers-Malinverno 2018 Xiamaling · Nanfen 2023 · Moodies via Farhat 2022), all ≤1.3σ; genesis PINNED at the shipped 4498 Ma Roche crossing (the genesis chi² profile is flat — the data do not constrain it); pump factor 2.4σ preferred over zero, with the factor×window product the constrained quantity (0.454×~300 Myr ≈ 0.15×~900 Myr degeneracy recorded). Knot values are the shipped definition (metre-rounded at fit time). Consumed via @essrt/physics deltat/recession-history.
